official: 練馬区立小学校および中学校の学校医、学校歯科医ならびに学校薬剤師の公務災害補償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
committee: 文教児童青少年委員会

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案の内容

name: 学校医などへの公務災害補償額を引き上げ
summary: 区立小学校・中学校の学校医、学校歯科医、学校薬剤師への公務災害補償について、介護補償の限度額と休業補償などの計算の基礎となる額を引き上げます。条例は公布の日に施行されます。
changes: 介護補償の限度額を引き上げる
休業補償等に係る補償基礎額を引き上げる
who: 区立小学校・中学校の学校医、学校歯科医、学校薬剤師
why: 東京都との均衡を図るためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Raises public-service accident compensation for school physicians and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Public-Service Accidents Involving School Physicians, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Nerima City Elementary and Junior High Schools
en.summary: For public-service accident compensation for school physicians, school dentists, and school pharmacists at Nerima City elementary and junior high schools, the maximum amount of nursing care compensation and the amount used as the basis for calculating leave compensation and related benefits will be raised. The ordinance will take effect on the day it is promulgated.
changes: Raises the maximum amount of nursing care compensation
Raises the compensation base amount used for leave compensation and related benefits
who: School physicians, school dentists, and school pharmacists at Nerima City elementary and junior high schools
en.why: The ward says this is to maintain balance with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government.
